title: Conditional κ = 7.11948953756315e-4: target-prefix compression (209 square groups) composed with the multi-cut kernel condensation
body:
Conditional κ = `142389790751263/(2·10^17)` = **7.11948953756315e-4**: +4.9 × 10⁻⁷ over [#270](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/270) (7.114579e-4), +5.2 × 10⁻⁷ over #269/#266, +9.2 × 10⁻⁶ (+0.129 %) over [#259](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/259). Stacked on #269's branch (PR259's package + supplementary families + retiming).

**Full replay: PASS.** `verify.py --output /tmp/multicut-target-prefix-replay` on the committed package (`45f13d0`): baseline regenerated from source, transform with the supplementary families, target-prefix stage, retiming stage, all seven native checkers, every pinned receipt matched — `PASS: kappa = 0.000711948953756315`, `PASS_ALL_SEVEN_NATIVE_CHECKERS_AND_PINNED_RECEIPTS`. (#272 appeared while this was running and is higher; see its comparison in the body.)

## What is new: eumemic's target-prefix compression, composed with the kernel condensation

[#268](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/268) (eumemic) introduced exact F₂ target-prefix compression on the #251 + 132-pair word. Nobody had composed it with the multi-cut condensation lineage; this PR does, natively, as a stage `code/target_prefix.py` between `cohort-transform` and the native checkers.

On this word every target reads five rank-20 entrance helpers at a 20-dimensional frame right after the forward phase. In each of **209 squares of four targets**, each such helper is read by exactly two of the four, so the dependent target's prefix response is the F₂ sum of its three square-mates' responses. The dependent's 1,057 frame-20 reads are omitted; it receives `t −= p_j` at the zero frame at the cut (record 670,678) and `t += p_j` at the square's common nondegenerate 21-dimensional frame at the close (right after the frame-20 block), where all four members are moved; the dependent's later reads at that frame and above are unchanged. Its chain ZERO →(20)→(1)→ 21 becomes ZERO →(21)→ 21. Histogram delta: {1: −209, 2: −7, 3: −1, 8: −1, 12: −1, 17: −1, 18: −7, 20: −200, 21: +209} at unchanged rank mass; the price moves from 7.11426e-4 to 7.11946e-4 before the retiming.

The stage recomputes every member's literal prefix response from the actual transcript (no group is trusted), requires the dependency and that no member is used as a source or receives a target before its close, rebuilds every MOVE from the actual needs, checks nested chains, fixed endpoints and COPY lifetimes, nondegenerate endpoint bases, and runs both all-column replays with an omitted-setup negative control; it then folds its delta into the replay receipt so the native price checker still regresses the #249 baseline exactly. Setup/restore gates carry two new category ids.

Also in this package (from #269): 365 net-positive supplementary equal-response pivot families (366 entrance-rank units, 363 kept by the transform's mod-3 normalization) supplied through `cohort-transform`'s own extra-candidate interface, and the 25-gate concave-descent retiming re-searched on the final transcript. Normalized retained profile: stock 173,313, 3,962,600 calls, rank mass 20,762,360, deficit 35,200.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/multicut-kernel-condensation/requirements.txt
python3 research/multicut-kernel-condensation/verify.py --output /tmp/multicut-target-prefix-replay
```

Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, C++17 GNU-compatible compiler and Boost headers; new output directory outside the package; no network. `verify.py` pins and checks the transcript hash after each stage (`cohort_record_sha256`, `target_record_sha256`, `new_record_sha256` in `RESULT.json`); `cohort-transform.cpp` uses `stable_sort` so the transcript is byte-identical across standard libraries.

## Scope and credits

Exactly #259's hypotheses and conditional interfaces; #259's caveat applies (the public eight-stage Python command is not replayed on this word; the native checkers are). No unconditional multiplication bound, benchmark or Lean certificate is claimed. The fixed-prime refinement (#265-style) is not included here and composes on top.

eumemic (#268: the target-prefix compression mechanism; #249, #244, #210), Dugongue (#259, #254: the multi-cut condensation, native checkers and packaging), and the retained lineage. The native target-prefix stage, the square search on this word, the supplementary families, the retiming and this package's rebinding were prepared by Rohan Arun with Anthropic Claude assistance.
